description: This source file defines the ChangeLogDetective class, which is responsible for identifying the Liquibase change logs used to initialize an OpenMRS database and which need to be run for updates. It includes logic for version detection, unrun change set identification, and logging.

classes.name: ChangeLogDetective
classes.description: Main class responsible for detecting the relevant Liquibase change logs and snapshots related to OpenMRS database initialization and updates.

classes.name: ChangeLogDetective.ChangeLogDetectiveHolder
classes.description: Inner static holder class implementing lazy-loaded singleton pattern for ChangeLogDetective.

classes.name: ChangeLogDetective.ChangeLogVersionFinder
classes.description: Member variable for version finding logic; assumes existence of associated class for version operations.

classes.name: ChangeLogDetective.LiquibaseProvider
classes.description: Interface or class providing access to Liquibase instances; used to abstract Liquibase creation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ChangeLogDetective.

methods.name: getInitialLiquibaseSnapshotVersion
methods.description: Determines the Liquibase snapshot version used to initialize the database.

methods.name: getUnrunLiquibaseUpdateFileNames
methods.description: Returns list of update files containing unrun change sets based on snapshot version.

methods.name: getSnapshotVersionsInDescendingOrder
methods.description: Sorts snapshot versions in descending order.

methods.name: excludeVintageChangeSets
methods.description: Filters out vintage or specific change sets based on defined criteria.

methods.name: getUnrunChangeSets
methods.description: Retrieves unrun change sets using Liquibase status command.

methods.name: isVintageChangeSet
methods.description: Determines if a change set is vintage based on filename and author.

methods.name: logUnRunChangeSetDetails
methods.description: Logs details of unrun change sets, limited to a maximum number.
